findings: 两源只提供metadata freeze、独立纯推理worker、完整后唯一verifier及controller；未调用旧make_method、训练、作者E回调或CPU门。
metadata显式绑定原screen READY的manifest/SPLIT SHA，并封原task顺序100DEV ID序列SHA；freeze绑定该旧READY，worker/verifier共用同链。TRAIN容器仅按冻结DEV ID过滤，无重分组。
freeze验证SOURCE_REVIEW的NECESSITY实际SHA、最终协议SHA及精确两源集合；READY/check_ready封源、依赖、安装源、解释器与元数据链。
真实加载固定BF16、视觉eager/语言SDPA并拒绝四类loading错误；输入保持原native runtime政策，超长或停止语义歧义即失败。没有静默截断或输出质量修补路径。
generate覆写沿原固定调用，仅同一输出增加末token与EOS/cap终止证据，不增加模型请求。精确100请求/输入ID顺序/全部原refs/输入及图像SHA在完整后核验。
全模型requires_grad=False、eval、inference_mode；完整state digest及布局前后一致，实际完整权重/共享存储与派生buffer分别报告；无adapter、专家或optimizer。
原score/tokens AST由封SHA原runtime_utils提取，取score字典token_f1并以全部refs计分；VERIFY_STARTED防重入，完整退出后只评分一次。
worker alarm及controller独立单调钟3600秒边界同时存在；controller只验证并终止自己的PID/startticks/UID/隔离PGID，失败停止，75仅无STARTED/private的未尝试等待。
limitations: This review did not execute either source as a module or run metadata freeze, Torch, model, tensor, QA, generation, GPU, scoring, bootstrap or any CPU admission.
Metadata READY is not runtime admission: complete BF16 loading, native EOS/input behavior, actual storage counts and answer quality remain unproved.
A separate independent ADMISSION_REVIEW tied to the actual READY is required before controller activation; this file grants no activation.

This is a previously missing fixed starting baseline, not a novelty, parameter-avoidability, RW/RS, compact-method or stable-capability result. The explored DEV cannot support a positive-retain/negative-discard carrier search.
Closed E/Q/R v1/v2 and other historical branches remain closed; this review does not relax their failed gradient parity criterion or authorize v3.
